requiredFindings.title: Recheck treats an mtime, ctime, or link-count change as a birth mismatch
requiredFindings.failureScenario: ProjectChain::recheck refuses Changed when the new DirectoryBirthObservation is not PartialEq to the retained one. Equality includes DescriptorMetadata, so mtime, ctime, link count, size, and mode are part of the birth. Creating a file in the admitted root changes mtime and ctime. Creating .opensip also changes the link count. Device, inode, and native birth stay the same, and custody still passes. row() reports PROJECT.ROOT_CUSTODY_REFUSED subject name-changed. Item 3 rechecks identity (device and inode), name, and custody, and adds native birth. Item 6 step 6 runs that recheck after creating .opensip. mtime and ctime are the forbidden birth substitutes. Required: the birth matches when device, inode, birth seconds, and birth nanoseconds match. A real change of those fields still refuses. Mode, owner, and ACL stay in the custody judgment already rerun.

requiredFindings.title: Placement and the retained spelling allocate outside their charges
requiredFindings.failureScenario: placement_cost reserves 0 objects, 1 edge, and the two path lengths. Inside that reservation, placement allocates two Vec<Vec<u8>> and one Vec<u8> per component of H and of the root. A ledger with no objects remaining, and with that edge and those bytes remaining, still allocates the vectors. After the last charge, walk_project_chain copies root.to_path_buf() into ProjectChain.spelling with no reservation. Item 9 charges every step before it runs. The 64-level ledger total is 577 objects, 10937 edges, and 1092854 bytes, which is the charged total only. Required: reserve the component vectors in placement_cost before they are allocated, and reserve the retained spelling before the copy. A comparison that does not allocate closes the placement half.

scope: X2a implements X2 r5 items 1 to 3, the custody half of item 4, and item 9, except the two findings. RF-1: recheck equality includes mtime, ctime, and link count. RF-2: placement vectors and the retained spelling are uncharged. Judgment calls 1 to 6 are acceptable. Inventory v84 adds two files on v83 and is ACCEPT. Replay: security lib 14 passed. The 64-level ledger recorded 577 objects, 10937 edges, 1092854 bytes. Workspace suite, clippy, fmt, and check_package_edges were not replayed.
